<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

The services the project needs to run locally, in compose.yaml for Docker Compose: task up starts them and waits until they are ready, task down stops them (docker compose down -v also deletes their data). Other blueprints add their services. Everything is prefixed with name, the app's by default: the Compose project, its containers (loja-postgres) and volumes (loja-postgres-data), easy to tell apart in Docker.

```esquadro
blueprint compose
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/): the app must use them too.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | `""` | Prefix of the Compose project, its containers and volumes; the app's name when empty. Change it when two of your apps share a name. |
| `ports` | list | `[]` | Ports the services listen on locally, as "service:port", e.g. ["postgres:5433"] when another project already uses 5432. |

```esquadro
blueprint compose {
  name ""
}
```

## Slots

Other blueprints add code at these points (see [Writing a blueprint](/esquadro/writing-blueprints/#slots)).

| Slot | |
|---|---|
| `compose.services` | Services of compose.yaml, indented by two spaces; a blank line goes between contributions. Give containers the prefix with container_name, and volumes with their name property (Compose would add the project otherwise); the prefix is or (index (optionsOf "compose") "name") .App.Kebab. |
| `compose.volumes` | Named volumes of compose.yaml, indented by two spaces, each with a name: property with the prefix. |
